metadata.description: Twenty-six-item generic quality-of-life questionnaire covering four domains and two general items.
metadata.intended_use: Health, rehabilitation, public-health, and clinical research assessment of subjective quality of life.
metadata.name_origin: WHOQOL-BREF is the brief form of the World Health Organization Quality of Life assessment.
metadata.development_history: Developed by the WHOQOL Group as a shorter international form with translated versions, including German resources hosted by WHO.
metadata.measurement_rationale: Quality of life is assessed as a person’s perception of their position in life across physical, psychological, social, and environmental contexts.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Use WHO scoring syntax and the exact translation; domain scores are not diagnoses and are not interchangeable with EQ-5D or SF-36 scores.

versions.source_citation: The WHOQOL Group (1998). Development of the World Health Organization WHOQOL-BREF quality of life assessment.

source_documents.title: WHOQOL-BREF official German translation and scoring resources
source_documents.license_name: WHO source; translation and permission terms require exact-use review
source_documents.permission_basis: Only bibliographic and discovery metadata is stored. Questionnaire wording and forms are not included until exact edition, language, and reuse terms are verified.
